scenario.highLevelScenario: Netting workflow - 20 trades. Manual Affirmation Central Account -ACK
notes: 20 trades with exactly the same economics, injected one at a time so the simulator is called 20 times. "repeat": 20 makes 20 copies of the entry, and each generates its own tradeId, tradeSideId, uniqueTransactionId and party references, so they are 20 distinct trades, not duplicates.

The sheet states the trade as USD 10000 against CNH 67400. The netting rule is configured CNH-USD, in alphabetical order, so the pair is carried as CNHUSD with each amount on its own currency: 67400 CNH base, 10000 USD reference, as TC017 and TC026 carry the same sheet values. direction and Against list both options; the first of each, Buy and Base, is used, matching the rest of the pack: BNKA-HK is the base currency buyer, partyDirection Buy.
Each trade runs to step 05b, not 05: the step order is 4, 5, 5b, so stopping at 5 would skip the Domain B check. Steps 04, 05 and 05b must genuinely pass for every trade.

Once all 20 have run, the top-level nettingTotal checks them as one netting group: steps 06 to 07b find the group from the first trade, then the netting total check (07c) reads the group 07 / 07b found and checks what it nets to on both domains.

The amounts the group must hold are not typed here. utils/sum_storer.py adds each trade to the row's sum as it is booked, reading every amount with its own currency straight from the injected payload: 20 x 67400 = 1348000 CNH and 20 x 10000 = 200000 USD, which BNKA-HK receives and pays respectively. Steps 07c, 12 and 12b check the group's legs and settlement candidates against that stored sum, signed by direction, on both domains.

"runUpTo": "15b" then takes that group to settlement: close, status, proposal match (steps 10, 11 and 11b, run because the BNKA-HK / BNKB-NY spot rule in data/trade_scenarios.py is manual, as the sheet says; any other mode skips them), confirmation, settlement on all three sides, MT910 funding call and both ledgers. No expect, so every step must pass. If any trade failed one of its own steps, the group is checked but not closed or settled, and the row fails.
The group's steps run once for all 20 trades, after them, headed "TC012 netting group", and get one Excel row of their own after the 20 trade rows.
Settlement is the current date and tradeDate is the run date, both resolved from the run clock.
tradeReference, tradeReferenceSupplement and counterpartyReferenceNumber are free-text boxes, so they are generated per run as tradeId, the party partyTradeId and the counterparty partyTradeId.
ccpAlias, clearingBroker and counterpartyClearingBroker are blank in the sheet and have no wrapper field, so they are left out of the payload entirely.
Party CCP (PVPNONSTM) and Cpty CCP (NONPVPSTM) are legal-entity reference data in Baton, not trade fields, so they are recorded here and the payload carries the ordinary PVP settlement flag.
settlementCcy (USD) has no field in the wrapper, so it is recorded here only.
rate is carried as the sheet states it (2) even though 67400/10000 implies 6.74.
